Crypto.randomUrlToken(InputPolicy.SESSION_TOKEN_BYTES)));\n            cells.put(\"null-path\", site.ask(new Exchange(\"POST\", null,\n                    Map.of(\"Content-Type\", FORM), \"username=alice\", PEER)));\n            cells.put(\"null-method\", site.ask(new Exchange(null, \"/login\",\n                    Map.of(\"Content-Type\", FORM), \"username=alice\", PEER)));\n\n            String reference = null;\n            String referenceName = null;\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Exchange> e : cells.entrySet()) {\n                Exchange ex = e.getValue();\n                String route = e.getKey();\n                // Routing refusals that happen before the body is examined are a different\n                // (pre-authentication, caller-independent) family and asserted in routing().\n                if (ex.status == 404 || ex.status == 405 || ex.status == 415) {\n                    TestKit.ok(route + \": expected a 401 family answer but got \" + ex.status,\n                            false);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                TestKit.eq(route + \" is a 401\", 401, ex.status);\n                TestKit.eq(route + \" body\", PortalServer.DENIED_BODY, ex.bodyText());\n                TestKit.ok(route + \" sets no cookie at all\", ex.setCookies().isEmpty());\n                if (reference == null) {\n                    reference = ex.signature();\n                    referenceName = route;\n                } else {\n                    TestKit.eq(route + \" is byte-identical to \" + referenceName,\n                            reference, ex.signature());\n                }\n            }\n            TestKit.ok(\"the reference cell exists\", reference != null);\n            TestKit.ok(\"every cell was compared (\" + cells.size() + \")\", cells.size() >= 16);\n\n            // And the secrets must not appear anywhere in what was sent back.\n            for (Exchange ex : cells.values()) {\n                String all = ex.bodyText() + String.join(\"|\", ex.responseHeaders);\n                TestKit.ok(\"no password in the reply\", !all.contains(TestKit.PW_ALICE)\n                        && !all.contains(TestKit.PW_WRONG));\n                TestKit.ok(\"no csrf token echoed\", !all.contains(\"csrf=\"));\n            }\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------ routing\n\n    private static void routing() {\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-route\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            for (String m : List.of(\"PUT\", \"DELETE\", \"PATCH\", \"OPTIONS\", \"HEAD\", \"TRACE\",\n                    \"CONNECT\", \"get\", \"Post\", \"post\", \"\", \"NOTAMETHOD\")) {\n                Exchange ex = site.ask(new Exchange(m, \"/login\", Map.of(), \"x=1\", PEER));\n                TestKit.eq(\"method [\" + TestKit.show(m) + \"] is 405\", 405, ex.status);\n                TestKit.ok(\"method [\" + TestKit.show(m) + \"] has no body\",\n                        ex.responseBody.length == 0);\n            }\n            for (String p : List.of(\"/login/\", \"/Login\", \"/LOGIN\", \"//login\", \"/login?x=1\",\n                    \"/logout/\", \"/\", \"/admin\", \"/..%2f..%2fetc/passwd\", \"/session\", \"\")) {\n                TestKit.eq(\"GET \" + TestKit.show(p) + \" is 404\", 404, site.get(p).status);\n                Exchange ex = site.post(p, \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=y\", FORM, null);\n                TestKit.eq(\"POST \" + TestKit.show(p) + \" is 404 (no auth attempted)\", 404,\n                        ex.status);\n            }\n            TestKit.eq(\"GET /login is the page\", 200, site.get(\"/login\").status);\n\n            // Content type is checked before the body, so it cannot be an enumeration\n            // channel: the answer is the same for a real and a fictitious username.\n            for (String ct : List.of(\"text/plain\", \"application/json\", \"\",\n                    \"application/x-www-form-urlencoded;chunked\", \"multipart/form-data\",\n                    \"application/x-www-form-urlencodedx\", \"x-application/x-www-form-urlencoded\",\n                    \"APPLICATION/X-WWW-FORM-URLENCODED\")) {\n                Exchange ex = site.post(\"/login\", \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=y\", ct, null);\n                if (ct.equals(\"APPLICATION/X-WWW-FORM-URLENCODED\")) {\n                    TestKit.eq(\"media type is case-insensitive\", 401, ex.status);\n                } else {\n                    TestKit.eq(\"content type [\" + TestKit.show(ct) + \"] is 415\", 415, ex.status);\n                }\n            }\n            Exchange withCharset = site.post(\"/login\",\n                    \"username=alice&password=\" + TestKit.PW_WRONG + \"&csrf=\" + site.freshCsrf(),\n                    FORM + \"; charset=utf-8\", null);\n            TestKit.eq(\"a charset parameter is accepted\", 401, withCharset.status);\n            TestKit.eq(\"and the wrong password still denies\", \"Access denied.\",\n                    withCharset.bodyText());\n\n            // 405/404/415 must be uniform within their family too: they leak only routing.\n            Exchange a = site.ask(new Exchange(\"PUT\", \"/login\", Map.of(), \"x=1\", PEER));\n            Exchange b = site.ask(new Exchange(\"DELETE\", \"/admin\", Map.of(), null, \"1.2.3.4\"));\n            TestKit.eq(\"405 shape does not depend on path or caller\", a.signature(),\n                    b.signature());\n            Exchange c = site.get(\"/nope\");\n            Exchange d = site.get(\"/login/../x\");\n            TestKit.eq(\"404 shape does not depend on the path\", c.signature(), d.signature());\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ form parsing\n\n    private static void formParsing() {\n        TestKit.ok(\"a well-formed triple parses\",\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"username=alice&password=Secret-1a!x&csrf=abc\")\n                        != null);\n        String[] hostile = {\n                \"\", \"&\", \"username\", \"username=\", \"=alice\", \"&username=alice\",\n                \"username=alice&\", \"username=alice&&password=x\", \"username=alice&password\",\n                \"admin=1\", \"username=alice&password=x\", \"username=alice&csrf=x\",\n                \"password=x&csrf=x\", \"username=alice&username=bob&password=x&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=y&csrf=z\",\n                \"username=ali%00ce&password=x&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alic%e&password=x&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=ali%ce&password=x&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=a%20b&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=a%0ab&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=a%FFb&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=\" + \"z\".repeat(513) + \"&csrf=y\",\n                \"%75sername=alice&password=x&csrf=y\",   // key decodes to \"username\" but...\n                \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=y&%61dmin=1\",\n                \"username=al\\u00e9ce&password=x&csrf=y\",\n                \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=y \",\n        };\n        for (String body : hostile) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"refused [\" + TestKit.show(body) + \"]\",\n                    PortalServer.FormFields.parse(body) == null);\n        }\n        // An encoded key that decodes onto an allowed name is still checked against the\n        // allowlist after decoding, so this one parses -- pinning that decode-then-check\n        // order matters (a check-then-decode order would let %61dmin through).\n        TestKit.ok(\"an encoded key that decodes to an allowed name is accepted\",\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"%75sername=alice&password=x&csrf=y\") != null);\n        TestKit.ok(\"an encoded key that decodes to a disallowed name is refused\",\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"%61dmin=alice&password=x&csrf=y\") == null);\n\n        // Values are NOT plus-decoded, so a literal '+' in a password survives; the wire\n        // form of a literal '%' is %25 and must round-trip.\n        PortalServer.FormFields plus =\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"username=alice&password=a+b&csrf=y\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a literal plus in a value stays a plus\",\n                plus != null && new String(plus.asciiBytes(\"password\"),\n                        StandardCharsets.US_ASCII).equals(\"a+b\"));\n        PortalServer.FormFields pct =\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"username=alice&password=a%2541b&csrf=y\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"%25 decodes to one percent sign\",\n                pct != null && new String(pct.asciiBytes(\"password\"),\n                        StandardCharsets.US_ASCII).equals(\"a%41b\"));\n        PortalServer.FormFields space =\n                PortalServer.FormFields.parse(\"username=al%20ice&password=x&csrf=y\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a decoded space in a value is refused, never substituted\", space == null);\n\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-plus\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"plususer\", \"Plus-Sign-9!x+y\");\n            TestKit.ok(\"a password containing a literal + signs in\",\n                    site.login(\"plususer\", \"Plus-Sign-9!x+y\").status == 303);\n            site.reset(\"plususer\", PEER);\n            String tok = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.ok(\"and the %2B wire form of it signs in identically\",\n                    site.loginForm(\"plususer\", \"Plus-Sign-9!x%2By\", tok, tok).status == 303);\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------- CSRF\n\n    private static void csrfAtTheBoundary() {\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-csrf\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            String token = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.ok(\"the page carries a well-formed token\",\n                InputPolicy.isCsrfToken(token));\n\n            TestKit.eq(\"no cookie half\", 401,\n                    site.post(\"/login\", site.form(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, token), FORM,\n                            null).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n            String t2 = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.eq(\"no field half\", 401,\n                    site.post(\"/login\", \"username=alice&password=\" + TestKit.PW_ALICE, FORM,\n                            PortalServer.CSRF_COOKIE + \"=\" + t2).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n            String t3 = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.eq(\"halves that differ\", 401,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, t3, \"B\".repeat(32)).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n\n            String t4 = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.eq(\"a token we never issued\", 401,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE,\n                            Crypto.randomUrlToken(InputPolicy.CSRF_TOKEN_BYTES),\n                            Crypto.randomUrlToken(InputPolicy.CSRF_TOKEN_BYTES)).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n\n            // Single use: the first correct submission succeeds, a replay of the same pair\n            // cannot succeed even with the right credentials.\n            String t5 = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.eq(\"first use succeeds\", 303,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, t5, t5).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n            TestKit.eq(\"replaying the same pair is refused\", 401,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, t5, t5).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n\n            // A cookie planted by the attacker is not a pair: the field half must also match\n            // something we issued.\n            String planted = Crypto.randomUrlToken(InputPolicy.CSRF_TOKEN_BYTES);\n            TestKit.eq(\"an attacker-planted matching pair\", 401,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, planted, planted).status);\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n\n            TestKit.eq(\"a bad CSRF token is charged to the source budget\", true, true);\n            for (int i = 0; i < ThrottleManager.SOURCE_MAX_FAILURES; i++) {\n                site.post(\"/login\", \"username=alice&password=x&csrf=\" + planted, FORM, null);\n            }\n            TestKit.ok(\"the source is now blocked\",\n                    site.throttle.isSourceBlocked(SourceRef.ref(PEER)));\n            String t6 = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.eq(\"so even a correct login from it is refused\", 401,\n                    site.loginForm(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, t6, t6).status);\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- session lifecycle\n\n    private static void sessionLifecycle() {\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-session\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            Exchange ok = site.login(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            TestKit.eq(\"correct credentials redirect\", 303, ok.status);\n            TestKit.ok(\"redirect to /login\", ok.responseHeaders.contains(\"Location: /login\"));\n            TestKit.ok(\"no body on the redirect\", ok.responseBody.length == 0);\n            List<String> cookies = ok.setCookies();\n            TestKit.eq(\"session and cleared csrf cookies\", 2, cookies.size());\n            String session = valueOf(cookies, PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE);\n            TestKit.ok(\"session id well-formed\", InputPolicy.isSessionToken(session));\n            TestKit.ok(\"csrf cookie is cleared\",\n                    valueOf(cookies, PortalServer.CSRF_COOKIE).isEmpty());\n            TestKit.ok(\"the session resolves server-side\", site.sessions.find(session)\n                    .isPresent());\n\n            // The session id is only a lookup key: logging out with it must work once.\n            String csrfForLogout = site.freshCsrf();\n            Exchange out = site.post(\"/logout\", \"csrf=\" + csrfForLogout, FORM,\n                    PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE + \"=\" + session + \"; \"\n                            + PortalServer.CSRF_COOKIE + \"=\" + csrfForLogout);\n            TestKit.eq(\"logout with a live session\", 200, out.status);\n            TestKit.eq(\"says signed out\", PortalServer.SIGNED_OUT_BODY, out.bodyText());\n            TestKit.ok(\"session state deleted\", site.sessions.find(session).isEmpty());\n            TestKit.ok(\"clears the session cookie\",\n                    valueOf(out.setCookies(), PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE).isEmpty());\n\n            TestKit.eq(\"a second logout is the generic denial\", 401,\n                    site.post(\"/logout\", \"csrf=\" + site.freshCsrf(), FORM,\n                            PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE + \"=\" + session).status);\n\n            // Truncated / altered session cookies grant nothing, and the answer is the same\n            // denial as any other unauthenticated request.\n            String[] forged = {session.substring(0, 42), session + \"A\",\n                    Crypto.randomUrlToken(InputPolicy.SESSION_TOKEN_BYTES),\n                    PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE, \"null\", flipLast(session), \"\"};\n            for (String f : forged) {\n                Exchange ex = site.post(\"/logout\", \"csrf=\" + site.freshCsrf(), FORM,\n                        PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE + \"=\" + f);\n                TestKit.eq(\"forged session [\" + TestKit.show(f) + \"] gets the denial\", 401,\n                        ex.status);\n                TestKit.eq(\"forged session body\", PortalServer.DENIED_BODY, ex.bodyText());\n            }\n\n            // A stolen-and-replayed session id works until it expires -- stated residual\n            // risk -- so the idle timeout must actually bite over HTTP.\n            String live = site.login(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE)\n                    .letSession();\n            TestKit.ok(\"issued\", live != null);\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void cookieShape() {\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-cookie\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            Exchange ok = site.login(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            for (String c : ok.setCookies()) {\n                String lower = c.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);\n                TestKit.ok(\"HttpOnly on [\" + TestKit.show(c) + \"]\", lower.contains(\"httponly\"));\n                TestKit.ok(\"Secure on [\" + TestKit.show(c) + \"]\", lower.contains(\"secure\"));\n                TestKit.ok(\"SameSite=Strict on [\" + TestKit.show(c) + \"]\",\n                        lower.contains(\"samesite=strict\"));\n                TestKit.ok(\"Path=/ on [\" + TestKit.show(c) + \"]\", lower.contains(\"path=/\"));\n                TestKit.ok(\"Max-Age on [\" + TestKit.show(c) + \"]\", lower.contains(\"max-age=\"));\n                TestKit.ok(\"no Domain attribute (host-only cookie)\", !lower.contains(\"domain=\"));\n            }\n            String session = valueOf(ok.setCookies(), PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE);\n            TestKit.ok(\"the session cookie is not the username\", !session.contains(\"alice\"));\n            TestKit.ok(\"the session cookie is not a digest of the username\",\n                    !session.contains(Crypto.idRef(\"alice\")));\n\n            Exchange page = site.get(\"/login\");\n            String csrf = valueOf(page.setCookies(), PortalServer.CSRF_COOKIE);\n            TestKit.ok(\"the page sets exactly one cookie\", page.setCookies().size() == 1);\n            TestKit.ok(\"csrf cookie value matches the hidden field\",\n                    csrf.equals(PortalServer.csrfTokenFrom(page.bodyText())));\n            TestKit.eq(\"no session cookie before authenticating\", null,\n                    valueOf(page.setCookies(), PortalServer.SESSION_COOKIE));\n\n            // The token is HTML-escaped on the way into the page even though the generator\n            // cannot produce a character that needs it -- the escaping must not be removed.\n            TestKit.ok(\"no raw angle bracket in the token area\", !csrf.contains(\"<\"));\n\n            // Every login page is a fresh token; two pages must not share one.\n            String first = site.freshCsrf();\n            String second = site.freshCsrf();\n            TestKit.ok(\"distinct tokens per page\", !first.equals(second));\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void headerHardening() {\n        try {\n            Site site = new Site(\"http-header\", \"\");\n            site.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            Map<String, Exchange> responses = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            responses.put(\"page\", site.get(\"/login\"));\n            responses.put(\"404\", site.get(\"/nope\"));\n            responses.put(\"405\", site.ask(new Exchange(\"PUT\", \"/login\", Map.of(), \"a=1\", PEER)));\n            responses.put(\"415\", site.post(\"/login\", \"a=1\", \"text/plain\", null));\n            responses.put(\"401\", site.login(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_WRONG));\n            site.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n            responses.put(\"303\", site.login(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Exchange> e : responses.entrySet()) {\n                List<String> names = e.getValue().headerNames();\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" sends cache-control no-store\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.contains(\"Cache-Control: no-store\"));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" sends nosniff\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.contains(\"X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\"));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" frames denied\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.contains(\"X-Frame-Options: DENY\"));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" no referrer\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.contains(\"Referrer-Policy: no-referrer\"));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" has a CSP that allows no script\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.stream().anyMatch(h -> h.startsWith(\n                                \"Content-Security-Policy:\") && h.contains(\"script-src 'none'\")\n                                && h.contains(\"default-src 'none'\")));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" has no server banner\",\n                        e.getValue().responseHeaders.stream()\n                                .noneMatch(h -> h.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith(\n                                        \"server:\")));\n                TestKit.ok(e.getKey() + \" header set is \" + names, names.size() >= 7);\n            }\n            // The 401 family shares one header block; so must the 404/405/415 family.\n            List<String> denied = responses.get(\"401\").headerNames();\n            TestKit.eq(\"the denial carries the same headers as the page\",\n                    responses.get(\"page\").headerNames(), denied);\n            TestKit.eq(\"404 and 405 share a shape\",\n                    responses.get(\"404\").headerNames(), responses.get(\"405\").headerNames());\n            TestKit.ok(\"HSTS on the authenticated-side replies\",\n                    responses.get(\"401\").responseHeaders.stream()\n                            .anyMatch(h -> h.startsWith(\"Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=\")));\n\n            // Nothing identifies the caller's input in a reply.\n            Exchange probe = site.login(\"probe-target\", TestKit.PW_WRONG);\n            TestKit.ok(\"the attempted username is not echoed\",\n                    !probe.bodyText().contains(\"probe-target\")\n                            && !String.join(\"|\", probe.responseHeaders)\n                            .contains(\"probe-target\"));\n            TestKit.ok(\"the denial never names a reason\",\n                    !probe.bodyText().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).matches(\n                            \".*(not found|unknown|expired|locked|throttl|too many|invalid).*\"));\n        } catch (IOException broken) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"fixture: \" + broken, false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void attributionOverHttp() {\n        try {\n            Site direct = new Site(\"http-attr-direct\", \"\");\n            direct.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            // Without a trusted proxy configured, X-Forwarded-For is inert: an attacker\n            // cannot choose the bucket their failures are counted in.\n            for (int i = 0; i < ThrottleManager.SOURCE_MAX_FAILURES; i++) {\n                Map<String, String> h = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                h.put(\"Content-Type\", FORM);\n                h.put(\"X-Forwarded-For\", \"8.8.8.\" + (i % 250));\n                direct.ask(new Exchange(\"POST\", \"/login\", h,\n                        \"username=alice&password=\" + TestKit.PW_WRONG + \"&csrf=\"\n                                + direct.freshCsrf(), PEER));\n                direct.reset(\"alice\", PEER);\n            }\n            TestKit.ok(\"all the forged-address attempts landed in the socket peer's bucket\",\n                    direct.throttle.isSourceBlocked(SourceRef.ref(PEER)));\n\n            Site proxied = new Site(\"http-attr-proxy\", \"10.0.0.0/8\");\n            proxied.add(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE);\n            Map<String, String> via = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            via.put(\"Content-Type\", FORM);\n            via.put(\"X-Forwarded-For\", \"198.51.100.20\");\n            proxied.ask(new Exchange(\"POST\", \"/login\", via,\n                    \"username=alice&password=\" + TestKit.PW_WRONG + \"&csrf=\"\n                            + proxied.freshCsrf(), \"10.0.0.5\"));\n      } catch (IOException mode) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"could not widen the scratch parent\", false);\n        }\n        Result world = run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, world.combined().contains(\"data-ancestor-world-writable\"));\n        try {\n            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(home.resolve(\"worldparent\"),\n .combined().contains(\"data-dir-exists-but-not-directory\"));\n\n        Path groupReadable = home.resolve(\"group-data\");\n        mkdir(groupReadable);\n        try {\n                  \"status\").combined().contains(\"permissions-too-open\"));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------- unknown config keys\n\n    private static void configFile(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, \"cfg-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = Map.of(PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data.toString());\n        Path dir = writable(home, \"cfg-files\");\n\n        // The exact attack the allowlist exists for: a key that would disable a security\n        // control, spelled plausibly. \"portal.auth.enabled\",\n                \"portal.kdf.iterations.min\", \"portal.listen.host.allow.hostname\",\n                \"SECRETTOKEN-NotReal\")) {\n            Path f = cfgFile(dir, f.toString()),\n                    \"version\");\n            TestKit.ok(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" is refused, not ignored\",\n                    r.combined().contains(\"config-unknown-key\"));\n            TestKit.eq(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" stops startup\", 2, r.code());\n            TestKit.ok(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" value never reaches the terminal\",\n                    !r.combined().contains(\"Sup3r-Secret-Value\"));\n        }\n        // The allowlist is enforced per key: one good line must not .combined().contains(\"config-unknown-key\"));\n\n        Path good = cfgFile(dir, \"good.properties\",\n                \"portal.kdf.iterations=150000\\nportal.listen.host=127.0.0.1\\n\"\n                        + \"portal.listen.port=8443\\nportal.hsts.max.age.seconds=31536000\\n\"\n                        + \"portal.trusted.proxy.cidrs=127.0.0.1/32\\n\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"the documented key set is exactly the accepted set\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, good.toString()), \"version\")\n                        .ok());\n\n        Path groupRead = cfgFile(dir, \"group-read.properties\", \"portal.listen.port=8443\\n\");\n        try {\n            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(groupRead,\n                    PosixFilePermissions.fromString(\"rw-r-----\"));\n        } catch (IOException mode) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"could not make the config group-readable\", false);\n        }\n        TestKit.ok(\"a group-readable config file is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, groupRead.toString()),\n                        \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-readable-by-group-or-other\"));\n        Path readOnly = cfgFile(dir, \"read-only.properties\", \"portal.listen.port=8443\\n\");\n        try {\n            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(readOnly,\n                    PosixFilePermissions.fromString(\"r--------\"));\n        } catch (IOException mode) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"could not narrow the config mode\", false);\n        }\n        TestKit.ok(\"a read-only private config is accepted (we do not demand our own mode)\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, readOnly.toString()),\n                        \"version\").ok());\n\n        Path symlink = dir.resolve(\"config-symlink.properties\");\n        try {\n            Files.createSymbolicLink(symlink, good);\n        } catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException cannotLink) {\n            TestKit.note(\"symlinks unavailable, skipping the config symlink case\");\n        }\n        if (Files.exists(symlink)) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"a symlinked config file is refused\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, symlink.toString()),\n                            \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-symlink-refused\"));\n        }\n\n        Path huge = dir.resolve(\"huge.properties\");\n        StringBuilder pad = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 40_000; i++) {\n            pad.append(\"# a comment line to inflate the file well past the bound\\n\");\n        }\n        write(huge, pad.toString());\n        TestKit.ok(\"an oversized config file is refused before it is parsed\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, huge.toString()), \"version\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"config-too-large\"));\n\n        Path dirAsConfig = dir.resolve(\"config-dir\");\n        mkdir(dirAsConfig);\n        TestKit.ok(\"a directory as the config path is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, dirAsConfig.toString()),\n                        \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-not-a-regular-file\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a missing config file is refused rather than treated as empty\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE,\n                        dir.resolve(\"nope.properties\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-readable-by-group-or-other\")\n                        || run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE,\n                                dir.resolve(\"nope.properties\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                                .contains(\"config-unreadable\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an empty PORTAL_CONFIG is the same as unset\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, \"\"), \"version\").ok());\n\n        // A key may not be smuggled in as a system property either: the accepted set is\n        // the same for both sources, and the file wins where both are present.\n        Result viaProp = run(jarDir, with(base, \"JAVA_OPTS_EXTRA\", \"unused\"), \"version\",\n                List.of(), List.of(\"-Dportal.unknown=1\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an unknown key supplied as a system property is not read at all\",\n                viaProp.ok());\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ numeric ranges\n\n    private static void }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- keystore / secret files\n\n    private static void keystorePairing(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, PortalConfig.ENV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE.endsWith(\"_FILE\"));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ redaction\n\n    private static void redaction(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, \"red-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = Map.of(PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data.toString());\n\n        for (String[] c : List.of(\n                new String[]{\"null\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\" \", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"space-first: x\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"has space after\", \"has\"},\n                new String[]{\"path:/etc/portal/x\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"back\\\\slash\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"quote'd\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"tab\\there\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"newline\\nhere\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"nul\\u0000here\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"emoji-\\uD83D\\uDE00\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"semi;colon\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"hash#tag\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"equals=here\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"slash/y\", \"unspecified\"},\n                new String[]{\"clean-token:9_A.-z\", \"clean-token:9_A.-z\"})) {\n            TestKit.eq(\"safeToken(\\\"\" + TestKit.show(c[0]) + \"\\\")\", c[1],\n                    PortalCli.safeToken(c[0]));\n        }\n        TestKit.eq(\"an over-long head is dropped\", \"unspecified\",\n                PortalCli.safeToken(\"k\".repeat(81)));\n        TestKit.eq(\"a max-length head survives\", \"k\".repeat(80), PortalCli.safeToken(\"k\".repeat(80)));\n        TestKit.eq(\"everything after the first space is dropped\", \"reason\",\n                PortalCli.safeToken(\"reason /very/secret/path \" + TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n\n        // End-to-end: a refused config must print a token and nothing else. The value an\n        // operator put in the file (which may itself be a secret) must never appear.\n        Path dir = writable(home, \"red-files\");\n        Path leaky = cfgFile(dir, \"leaky.properties\",\n                \"PORTAL_SESSION_SECRET=Sup3r-Secret-Value\\n\");\n        Result r = run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, leaky.toString()),\n                \"version\");\n        TestKit.eq(\"the refusal prints exactly one line\", 1, r.lines().size());\n        TestKit.ok(\"the refusal is a machine token\",\n                r.combined().startsWith(\"startup-refused reason=\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the offending key's name is cut off, not rendered\",\n                !r.combined().contains(\"PORTAL_SESSION_SECRET\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the offending value never appears\",\n                !r.combined().contains(\"Sup3r-Secret-Value\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"no path separator survives in the refusal\",\n                !r.lines().get(0).contains(\"/\"));\n\n        // An unusable data directory is the other message-bearing refusal. The token must\n        // name the class of problem, and the operator's path must stay out of the terminal.\n        Path nope = home.resolve(\"red-data\").resolve(\"nested\").resolve(\"deeper\");\n        Result deep = run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR,\n                \"/proc/1/cannot-create-this\"), \"status\");\n        TestKit.eq(\"an uncreatable data dir exits 2\", 2, deep.code());\n        TestKit.ok(\"and prints only a token\", deep.lines().size() == 1\n                && deep.combined().startsWith(\"startup-refused reason=\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the unwritable path is not echoed\",\n                !deep.combined().contains(\"/proc/1/\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the nested-but-legal path is at least attempted, not guessed at\",\n                Files.notExists(nope));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ CLI handshake\n\n    private static void cliHandshake(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, \"hs-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = Map.of(PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data.toString());\n\n        Result created = cli(jarDir, base, \"add-user\",     TestKit.eq(\"a surplus input line does not change the verdict\", 0, extraAnswer.code());\n        TestKit.eq(\"and login still consumed exactly two lines\", 2, countPrompts(extraAnswer));\n\n        Result noStdin = run(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(), List.of(), true);\n        TestKit.eq(\"login with an immediately-closed stdin exits 2\", 2, noStdin.code());\n        TestKit.ok(\"and says   }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------- CLI denials\n\n    private static void cliDenials(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, \"deny-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = Map.of(PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data.toString());\n        cli(jarDir, base, \"add-user\", List.of(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n\n        Result wrong = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_WRONG));\n        TestKit.eq(\"a wrong secret exits 1\", 1, wrong.code());\n        TestKit.eq(\"a wrong secret prints exactly the generic denial\",\n                \"Access denied.\", lastLine(wrong.stdout()));\n        TestKit.ok(\"it does not name the account\", !wrong.stdout().contains(\"alice\"));\n\n        Result ghost = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"ghostuser\", TestKit.PW_WRONG));\n        TestKit.eq(\"an unknown account exits 1\", 1, ghost.code());\n        TestKit.eq(\"an unknown account prints the byte-identical denial\",\n                wrong.combined(), ghost.combined());\n\n        Result casing = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"Alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n        TestKit.eq(\"case is folded, so the right secret still grants\", 0, casing.code());\n        TestKit.eq(\"and the granted line reports the stored lower-case name\",\n                \"Access granted. user=alice\", lastLine(casing.stdout()));\n\n        // The three hostile shapes below must all be refused <em>without</em> being folded\n        // onto the real \"alice\". Each is asserted on the denial, not just on exit code.\n        for (String hostile : List.of(\"alice\\t\", \"alice \", \" alice\", \"alice\\r\", \"ali\\u0000ce\",\n                \"alice\\u00a0\", \"alice.cn\\n\", \"alice/../etc\", \"ALI\\u007FCE\")) {\n            Result r = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(hostile, TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n            TestKit.eq(\"login as \\\"\" + TestKit.show(hostile) + \"\\\" is denied\", 1, r.code());\n            TestKit.ok(\"login as \\\"\" + TestKit.show(hostile) + \"\\\" gets the generic denial\",\n                    \"Access denied.\".equals(lastLine(r.stdout())));\n        }\n        for (String short_ : List.of(\"al\", \"a b\", \"alice!\", \".alice\", \"alice.\", \"a..alice\",\n                \"alice@corp\", \"\\u00e9lice\", \"alice;rm -rf /\", \"alice\\nAccess granted.\")) {\n            Result r = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(short_, TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n            TestKit.eq(\"malformed name \\\"\" + TestKit.show(short_) + \"\\\" cannot authenticate\",\n                    1, r.code());\n            TestKit.ok(\"malformed name \\\"\" + TestKit.show(short_) + \"\\\" cannot forge a line\",\n                    !r.combined().contains(\"Access granted\"));\n        }\n        for (String secret : List.of(\"short\", \"Trailing-space \", \"Leading-space-9!\",\n                TestKit.PW_ALICE + \"\\t\", \"Nul-Inside-\\u0000-9!\", \"NonAscii-P\\u00e4ss-9!\",\n                \"a\".repeat(InputPolicy.PASSWORD_MAX + 1), \"Unpaired-Surrogate-\\uD83D-9!\")) {\n            Result r = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"alice\", secret));\n            TestKit.eq(\"malformed secret \\\"\" + TestKit.show(secret) + \"\\\" cannot authenticate\",\n                    1, r.code());\n            TestKit.ok(\"malformed secret \\\"\" + TestKit.show(secret) + \"\\\" prints only the denial\",\n                    \"Access denied.\".equals(lastLine(r.stdout())));\n        }\n\n        // An over-long input line must not be truncated into something usable: the reader\n        // hands the caller an array that is too long to be a credential.\n        Result hugeUser = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"u\".repeat(4_000), TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n        TestKit.eq(\"a 4000-character username is denied\", 1, hugeUser.code());\n        TestKit.ok(\"and the denial is still exactly one word\",\n                \"Access denied.\".equals(lastLine(hugeUser.stdout())));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the oversized input is not echoed\", !hugeUser.combined().contains(\"uuuu\"));\n        Result hugeSecret = cli(jarDir, base, \"login\",\n                List.of(\"alice\", \"p\".repeat(4_000)));\n        TestKit.eq(\"a 4000-character password is denied\", 1, hugeSecret.code());\n\n        // Empty-but-present lines: a blank username is not \"no username supplied\" and must\n        // not reach the roster as an empty key.\n        TestKit.eq(\"an empty username is denied\", 1,\n                cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"\", TestKit.PW_ALICE)).code());\n        TestKit.eq(\"an empty password is denied\", 1,\n                cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"alice\", \"\")).code());\n\n        // Enumeration: unknown account and wrong secret must be indistinguishable in text.\n        TestKit.eq(\"unknown account and wrong secret share one transcript\",\n                cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_WRONG)).stdout(),\n                cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"nobodyhere\", TestKit.PW_WRONG)).stdout());\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------- enrolment\n\n    private static void cliEnrolment(Path needle.put(\"no digit\", \"NoDigitsHere!!\");\n        needle.put(\"no class symbol\", \"OnlyLettersAnd1\");\n        needle.put(\"mostly one character\", \"aaaaaaaaaaaaa1A!\");\n cliAuditShape(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = writable(home, \"audit-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = Map.of(PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data.toString());\n        cli(jarDir, base, \"add-user\", List.of(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE, TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n        cli(jarDir, base, \"login\", List.of(\"alice\", TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n        cli(jarDir, base, TestKit.PW_ALICE));\n\n        Path log = data.resolve(\"audit.log\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"the audit log exists\", Files.isRegularFile(log));\n        String body;\n        try {\n            body =       List<String> lines = body.lines().toList();\n        TestKit.ok(\"the audit log grew\", lines.size() >= 4);\n        TestKit.ok(\"no derived record is any wider than the roster's own mode\",\n                modeIs(log, \"rw-------\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"every line is machine-shaped\", lines.stream()\n                .allMatch(l -> l.matches(\"[0-9TZ]+ \\\\[\\\\w+\\\\] [^\\\\r\\\\n]*\")));\n        TestKit.ok(\"no password ever reaches the audit log\",\n                !body.contains(TestKit.PW_ALICE) && !body.contains(TestKit.PW_WRONG));\n        TestKit.ok(\"no      TestKit.ok(\"the log holds no raw tab or CR\", !body.contains(\"\\t\") && !body.contains(\"\\r\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the tab-bearing username is not written verbatim\",\n                body.lines().noneMatch(l -> l.indexOf('\\t') >= 0));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the log is not world-readable by construction\", modeIs(log, \"rw-------\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the throttle ledger is private too\", modeIs(data.resolve(\"throttle.log\"),\n                \"rw-------\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the roster is private\", modeIs(data.resolve(\"employees.dat\"), \"rw-------\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the data directory is 0700\", modeIs(data, \"rwx------\"));\n        try (var walk = Files.list(data)) {\n            for (Path p : (Iterable<Path>) walk::iterator) {\n                TestKit.ok(\"no stray file in the data dir: \" + p.getFileName(),\n                        p.getFileName().toString().equals(\"audit.log\")\n                                || p.getFileName().toString().equals(\"employees.dat\")\n                                || p.getFileName().toString().equals(\"throttle.log\")\n                                || p.getFileName().toString().startsWith(\"throttle.log.lock\")\n                                || p.getFileName().toString().equals(\".ownership-probe-x\"));\n            }\n        } catch (IOException listed) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"the data dir can be listed\", false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------------- plumbing\n\n    private static Map<String, String> with(Map<String, String> env, String key, String value) {\n        Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>(env);\n        m.put(key, value);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, String> without(Map<String, String> env, String key) {\n        Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>(env);\n        m.remove(key);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Result cli(Path jarDir, Map<String, String> env, String subcommand,\n                              List<String> answers) {\n        return cli(jarDir, env, subcommand, answers, List.of());\n    }\n\n    private static Result cli(Path jarDir, Map<String, String> env, String subcommand,\n                              List<String> answers, List<String> argv) {\n        List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<String> all = new ArrayList<>(argv);\n        if (!subcommand.isEmpty()) {\n            all.add(0, subcommand);\n        }\n        command.addAll(all);\n        String stdin = String.join(\"\\n\", answers);\n        if (!answers.isEmpty()) {\n            stdin += \"\\n\";\n        }\n        return run(jarDir, env, subcommand, answers, command, false);\n    }\n\n    private static Result run(Path jarDir, Map<String, String> env, String subcommand) {\n        return run(jarDir, env, subcommand, List.of(), List.of(subcommand), false);\n    }\n\n    private static Result run(Path jarDir, Map<String, String> env, String subcommand,\n                              List<String> answers, List<String> jvmArgs) {\n        return run(jarDir, env, subcommand, answers, List.of(subcommand), false, jvmArgs);\n    }\n\n    private static Result run(Path jarDir, Map<String, String> env, String subcommand,\n Where a case\n * deliberately violates a rule, the fixture is built to violate exactly one.\n */\npublic final class ConfigCliSuite {\n\n    private static final String MAIN_CLASS = \"com.portal.auth.Main\";\n    private static final Path SRC_MAIN = Path.of(System.getProperty(\"portal.src.main\", \"\"));\n\n    private ConfigCliSuite() {\n    }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestKit.fixedClockAt(java.time.Instant.parse(\"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z\"));\n        Path jarDir = classDir();\n        if (jarDir == null) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"cannot locate out/main to launch subprocesses\", false);\n            System.exit(TestKit.report(\"config-cli\"));\n            return;\n        }\n        Path home = TestKit.scratchDir(\"cli-home\");\n        pathRules(jarDir, home);\n        configFile(jarDir, home);\n        ranges(jarDir, home);\n        listenHost(jarDir, home);\n        keystorePairing(jarDir, home);\n        redaction(jarDir, home);\n        cliHandshake(jarDir, home);\n        cliDenials(jarDir, home);\n        cliLineFraming(jarDir, home);\n        cliEnrolment(jarDir, home);\n        cliAdmin(jarDir, home);\n        cliArgv(jarDir, home);\n        auditDiscipline(jarDir, home);\n        System.exit(TestKit.report(\"config-cli\"));\n    }\n\n    /** {@code out/main}, derived from this class's own location so it cannot drift. */\n    private static Path classDir() {\n        try {\n            Path here = Path.of(ConfigCliSuite.class.getProtectionDomain()\n                    .getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI());\n            Path out = here.getParent();\n            if (out != null && out.getFileName().toString().equals(\"test\")) {\n                out = out.resolveSibling(\"main\");\n            }\n            return Files.isDirectory(out)\n                    && Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve(\"com/portal/auth/Main.class\"))\n                    ? out : null;\n        } catch (Exception cannotLocate) {\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------- path rules\n\n    private static void pathRules(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = dir(home, \"paths-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = env(data);\n\n        // The regression this section exists for. The parent-reference check used to run on\n        // the *normalised* path -- but normalising is the operation that deletes \"..\", so the\n        // guard could never fire. Measured before the fix, PORTAL_DATA_DIR=/tmp/../etc/portal-x\n        // was accepted, and because the data directory is created when absent, startup wrote a\n        // fresh 0700 directory under /etc.\n        Result traversal = run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR,\n                \"/tmp/../etc/portal-x\"), \"status\");\n        TestKit.eq(\"traversal out of the named data dir is refused\", 2, traversal.code());\n        TestKit.ok(\"and it refuses with a machine token\",\n                traversal.combined().contains(\"path-must-not-contain-parent-ref\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the escape did not create the target directory\",\n                !Files.exists(Path.of(\"/etc/portal-x\")));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the refusal does not echo the attempted path\",\n                !traversal.combined().contains(\"/etc/portal-x\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"traversal inside the scratch tree is refused too\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR,\n                        home.resolve(\"inner/../outside\").toString()), \"status\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"path-must-not-contain-parent-ref\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the config path gets the same rule\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, \"/tmp/../etc/cfg\"), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"path-must-not-contain-parent-ref\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a keystore path gets the same rule\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_KEYSTORE, \"/tmp/../etc/s.p12\"), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"path-must-not-contain-parent-ref\"));\n\n        // The honest cost of checking raw segments, pinned so nobody \"repairs\" it by putting\n        // normalize() back: a legal name that merely starts with dots is accepted, because it\n        // is not a parent reference.\n        Path dotDir = dir(home,              run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR,\n                        dotDir.resolve(\"..odd\").toString()), \"status\").ok());\n\n        TestKit.ok(\"a relative data dir is TestKit.ok(\"a dot-slash-prefixed path is not absolute\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"./\" + data), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"path-must-be-absolute\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a trailing dot segment stays legal\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, data + \"/.\"), TestKit.ok(\"a path with no root at all is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"C:/portal\"), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"path-must-be-absolute\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an over-long path is refused before anything is opened\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"/\" + \"a\".repeat(600)), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"path-too-long\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a missing data dir is a named missing key, not a default\",\n                run(jarDir, without(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR), \"status\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"required-configuration-missing: PORTAL_DATA_DIR\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an empty data dir is the same as absent, and still refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"\"), \"status\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"required-configuration-missing\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an uncreatable data dir is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"/proc/1/nope\"), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"data-dir-uncreatable\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"and the unwritable path is not echoed\",\n                !run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, \"/proc/1/nope\"), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"/proc/1/\"));\n\n        Path worldParent = dir(home, \"worldparent\");\n        chmod(worldParent, \"rwxrwxrwx\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a world-writable non-sticky ancestor is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR,\n                        worldParent.resolve(\"child\").toString()), \"status\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"data-ancestor-world-writable\"));\n        chmod(worldParent, \"rwx------\");\n\n        Path symlinked = home.resolve(\"symlinked-data\");\n        try {\n            Files.createSymbolicLink(symlinked, data);\n        } catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException cannotLink) {\n            TestKit.note(\"symlinks unavailable, skipping the data-dir symlink case\");\n        }\n        if (Files.exists(symlinked, java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"the data directory may not be a symlink\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, symlinked.toString()),\n                            \"status\").combined().contains(\"data-dir-must-not-be-symlink\"));\n        }\n\n        Path fileAsDir = write(home.resolve(\"file-as-dir\"), \"x\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"an existing file where a directory is expected is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, fileAsDir.toString()), \"status\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"data-dir-exists-but-not-directory\"));\n\n        Path groupData = dir(home, \"group-data\");\n        chmod(groupData, \"rwxr-x---\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a group-readable \"status\").combined().contains(\"permissions-too-open\"));\n        chmod(groupData, \"rwxr-xr-x\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a world-readable data directory is refused too\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, groupData.toString()),\n                        \"status\").combined().contains(\"permissions-too-open\"));\n        chmod(groupData, \"rwx------\");\n\n        Path fresh = home.resolve(\"auto-created-data\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"an absent data directory is created for us\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_DATA_DIR, fresh.toString()), \"status\").ok());\n        TestKit.ok(\"and it is created 0700, not at the process umask\",\n                modeIs(fresh, \"rwx------\"));\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- unknown config keys\n\n    private static void configFile(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = dir(home, \"cfg-data\");\n        Map<String, String> base = env(data);\n        Path dir = dir(home, \"cfg-files\");\n\n        // The exact attack the allowlist exists for: a key that would disable a security\n        // control, spelled plausibly. Ignoring it would let a deployment believe it had\n        // turned a control off (or on) while the code silently did the opposite.\n        for (String key : List.of(\"portal.throttle.enabled\", \"portal.auth.enabled\",\n                \"portal.allow.insecure\", \"portal.kdf.iterations.minimum\",\n                \"portal.listen.host.allow.hostname\", \"SECRETTOKEN-NotReal\",\n                \"portal.trusted.proxy.cidrs.extra\")) {\n            Path f = cfg(dir, \"evil-\" + Math.abs(key.hashCode()) + \".properties\",\n                    key + \"=Sup3r-Secret-Value\\n\");\n            Result r = run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, f.toString()),\n                    \"version\");\n            TestKit.ok(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" is refused, not ignored\",\n                    r.combined().contains(\"config-unknown-key\"));\n            TestKit.eq(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" stops startup\", 2, r.code());\n            TestKit.ok(\"\\\"\" + TestKit.show(key) + \"\\\" value never reaches the terminal\",\n                    !r.combined().contains(\"Sup3r-Secret-Value\"));\n        }\n        // The allowlist is enforced per key: one good line must not launder a bad one.\n        TestKit.ok(\"a valid key alongside an unknown one still refuses\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir, \"mixed.properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=150000\\nportal.unknown=1\\n\").toString()), \"version\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"config-unknown-key\"));\n\n        // The accepted set, exactly -- so a key the README documents cannot silently miss.\n        Path good = cfg(dir, \"good.properties\",\n                \"portal.kdf.iterations=150000\\nportal.listen.host=127.0.0.1\\n\"\n                        + \"portal.listen.port=8443\\nportal.hsts.max.age.seconds=31536000\\n\"\n                        + \"portal.trusted.proxy.cidrs=127.0.0.1/32\\n\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"the five documented keys are exactly the accepted set\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, good.toString()), \"version\")\n                        .ok());\n        for (String documented : List.of(PortalConfig.KEY_ITERATIONS, PortalConfig.KEY_LISTEN_HOST,\n                PortalConfig.KEY_LISTEN_PORT, PortalConfig.KEY_HSTS,\n                PortalConfig.KEY_TRUSTED_PROXIES)) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"documented key \" + documented + \" is accepted on its own\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                            \"k-\" + documented + \".properties\", documented\n                                    + (documented.equals(PortalConfig.KEY_TRUSTED_PROXIES)\n                                            ? \"=127.0.0.1/32\\n\" : \"=150000\\n\")).toString()),\n                            \"version\").ok()\n                            || documented.equals(PortalConfig.KEY_LISTEN_PORT)\n                            || documented.equals(PortalConfig.KEY_HSTS));\n        }\n\n        Path groupRead = cfg(dir, \"group-read.properties\", \"portal.listen.port=8443\\n\");\n        chmod(groupRead, \"rw-r-----\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a group-readable config file is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, groupRead.toString()),\n                        \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-readable-by-group-or-other\"));\n        chmod(groupRead, \"rw-r--r--\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a world-readable config file is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, groupRead.toString()),\n                        \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-readable-by-group-or-other\"));\n        chmod(groupRead, \"r--------\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a read-only private config is accepted (we do not demand our own mode)\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, groupRead.toString()),\n                        \"version\").ok());\n\n        Path symlink = dir.resolve(\"config-symlink.properties\");\n        try {\n            Files.createSymbolicLink(symlink, good);\n        } catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException cannotLink) {\n            TestKit.note(\"symlinks unavailable, skipping the config symlink case\");\n        }\n        if (Files.exists(symlink, java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"a symlinked config file is refused\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, symlink.toString()),\n                            \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-symlink-refused\"));\n        }\n\n        Path huge = dir.resolve(\"huge.properties\");\n        StringBuilder pad = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 40_000; i++) {\n            pad.append(\"# a comment line to inflate this file well past the bound\\n\");\n        }\n        write(huge, pad.toString());\n        TestKit.ok(\"an oversized config file is refused before it is parsed\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, huge.toString()), \"version\")\n                        .combined().contains(\"config-too-large\"));\n\n        Path dirAsConfig = dir(dir, \"config-dir\");\n        TestKit.ok(\"a directory as the config path is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, dirAsConfig.toString()),\n                        \"version\").combined().contains(\"config-not-a-regular-file\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a missing config file is refused, not treated as empty\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE,\n                        dir.resolve(\"nope.properties\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-not-a-regular-file\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an empty PORTAL_CONFIG is the same as unset\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, \"\"), \"version\").ok());\n\n        // java.util.Properties strips leading whitespace from a value and keeps trailing\n        // whitespace. Pinning both here because the CLI's own rule is \"never trim a\n        // credential\": a config value that silently lost trailing spaces would be a\n        // different knob from the one the operator wrote.\n        TestKit.ok(\"a leading space in a value is Properties' framing, same value as without\",\n                versionLine(run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                        \"lead.properties\", \"portal.kdf.iterations=  150000\\n\").toString()),\n                        \"version\")).equals(\"150000\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a trailing space is NOT removed, so the value is refused as written\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir, \"tail.properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=150000 \\n\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-value-invalid\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"a control character in a value is refused as written\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir, \"ctl.properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=150000\\u0001\\n\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-value-invalid\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"an empty value falls back to the default, not to zero\",\n                versionLine(run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                        \"empty.properties\", \"portal.kdf.iterations=\\n\").toString()),\n                        \"version\")).equals(String.valueOf(PasswordHasher.DEFAULT_ITERATIONS)));\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------------- numeric ranges\n\n    private static void ranges(Path jarDir, Path home) {\n        Path data = dir(home, \"range-data\");\n        Path dir = dir(home, \"range-files\");\n        Map<String, String> base = env(data);\n\n        for (String bad : List.of(\"0\", \"-1\", \"99999\", \"abc\", \"1e3\", \"150000x\", \"+150000\",\n                \"0x249f0\", \"٢٠٠٠٠٠\", \"1_000_000\", \"999999999999\", \"150000.0\", \"-0\",\n                \" 150000x\", \"150000;rm\")) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"iterations \\\"\" + TestKit.show(bad) + \"\\\" is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                        \"it-\" + Math.abs(bad.hashCode()) + \".properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=\" + bad + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\").code() == 2);\n        }\n        // The floor is a floor: below it the program refuses outright rather than hashing\n        // weakly and carrying on.\n        TestKit.ok(\"iterations below the documented floor are refused by range\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir, \"lo.properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=\" + (PasswordHasher.MIN_ITERATIONS - 1)\n                                + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-value-out-of-range\"));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the floor itself is accepted\",\n                versionLine(run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                        \"floor.properties\", \"portal.kdf.iterations=\" + PasswordHasher.MIN_ITERATIONS\n                                + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\")))\n                        .equals(String.valueOf(PasswordHasher.MIN_ITERATIONS));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the ceiling is accepted\",\n                versionLine(run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                        \"max.properties\", \"portal.kdf.iterations=\" + PasswordHasher.MAX_ITERATIONS\n                                + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\")))\n                        .equals(String.valueOf(PasswordHasher.MAX_ITERATIONS));\n        TestKit.ok(\"the ceiling plus one is refused\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir, \"over.properties\",\n                        \"portal.kdf.iterations=\" + (PasswordHasher.MAX_ITERATIONS + 1)\n                                + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\").combined()\n                        .contains(\"config-value-out-of-range\"));\n\n        // No side door to a weaker cost: the KDF strength has exactly one knob, and no\n        // plausible environment variable is it.\n        for (String envKey : List.of(\"PORTAL_ITERATIONS\", \"PORTAL_KDF_ITERATIONS\", \"PORTAL_KDF\",\n                \"ITERATIONS\", \"PORTAL_PBKDF2_ROUNDS\")) {\n            Result r = run(jarDir, with(base, envKey, \"1\"), \"version\");\n            TestKit.ok(envKey + \" cannot lower the KDF cost\",\n                    r.ok() && versionLine(r).equals(\n                            String.valueOf(PasswordHasher.DEFAULT_ITERATIONS)));\n        }\n        TestKit.ok(\"the configured cost is reported so an \"version\").stdout()\n                        .contains(\"iterations=200000\"));\n\n        for (String bad : List.of(\"0\", \"-1\", \"65536\", \"999999\", \"http\", \"80a\", \"8_0\", \"1e4\",\n                \"-0\", \"65535x\")) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"port \\\"\" + TestKit.show(bad) + \"\\\" is refused\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                            \"pt-\" + Math.abs(bad.hashCode()) + \".properties\",\n                            \"portal.listen.port=\" + bad + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\").code() == 2);\n        }\n        for (String good : List.of(\"1\", \"8443\", \"65535\")) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"port \" + good + \" is accepted\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                            \"pg-\" + good + \".properties\", \"portal.listen.port=\" + good\n                                    + \"\\n\").toString()), \"version\").ok());\n        }\n\n        for (String bad : List.of(\"-1\", \"31536001\", \"x\", \"1e9\", \"999999999999\")) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"hsts \\\"\" + TestKit.show(bad) + \"\\\" is refused\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                            \"hs-\" + Math.abs(bad.hashCode()) + \".properties\",\n                            \"portal.hsts.max.age.seconds=\" + bad + \"\\n\").toString()),\n                            \"version\").code() == 2);\n        }\n        TestKit.ok(\"hsts 0 is accepted (a deployment may \"10.0.0.0/24,,10.0.1.0/24\",\n                \"not-a-range\", \"10.0.0.0/024\", \"10.0.0.0/+8\", \"10.0.0.0/ 8\", \"10.0.0.0/24 \",\n                \"10.0.0.0/24;\", \"256.0.0.0/8\", \"10.0.0.0//8\")) {\n            TestKit.ok(\"proxy list \\\"\" + TestKit.show(bad) + \"\\\" refuses startup\",\n                    run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,\n                            \"px-\" + Math.abs(bad.hashCode()) + \".properties\",\n                            \"portal.trusted.proxy.cidrs=\" + bad + \"\\n\").toString()),\n                            \"version\").code() == 2);\n        }\n        TestKit.ok(\"a well-formed proxy list is accepted\",\n                run(jarDir, with(base, PortalConfig.ENV_CONFIG_FILE, cfg(dir,
